title: Performance of Swarm Intelligence Algorithms for Cost Optimization of Indian Code-Compliant RC Frame Buildings

detail.title: Performance of Swarm Intelligence Algorithms for Cost Optimization of Indian Code-Compliant RC Frame Buildings
detail.abstract: This study compares four swarm intelligence metaheuristics, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Fully Informed PSO (FIPSO), Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), and Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), for minimum-cost design of a four-storey, four-bay reinforced concrete (RC) special moment-resisting frame in Indian Seismic Zone-V. Each algorithm is coupled with SAP2000 through its Open Application Programming Interface (OAPI), fully automating the analysis–design loop. The problem is cast as a 16-dimensional constrained nonlinear program with storey-grouped column sizes, beam depths, and longitudinal reinforcement ratios in beam and column as variables. A snap-and-hierarchy procedure enforces constructability, while explicit constraints impose IS 1893:2016 drift limits, IS 456:2000 strength provisions, and IS 13920:2016 ductility standards of 1.4 SCWB ratio at joints. PSO achieved the lowest material cost in 720 SAP2000 evaluations and is adopted as the benchmark; WOA, FIPSO, and GWO yielded cost premiums of 1.87%, 5.90%, and 12.04% in 580, 440, and 300 evaluations, respectively. Minimum SCWB ratios ranged from 1.574 to 2.255, and maximum drifts from 0.37% to 0.39%, well within the 0.40% code limit. PSO delivered the best solution quality, whereas FIPSO offered the most efficient evaluation-cost trade-off, requiring 39% fewer evaluations than PSO for a 5.90% cost premium. The study provides the complete multi-algorithm benchmark for IS code-compliant RC frame optimization integrated with SAP2000’s OAPI feature.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了四种群体智能元启发式算法（PSO、FIPSO、GWO、WOA）在印度地震V区四层四跨钢筋混凝土特殊抗弯框架最小成本设计中的表现。PSO以720次SAP2000评估获得最低材料成本；FIPSO以39%更少的评估次数仅产生5.90%的成本溢价，展现出最佳评估-成本权衡。所有方案均满足IS规范要求。
AI.research_question: 四种群体智能元启发式算法（PSO、FIPSO、GWO、WOA）在印度抗震规范约束下的RC框架最小成本优化中，哪种算法在解质量和计算效率上表现最优？
AI.motivation: RC框架的优化设计是一个高维约束非线性规划问题，传统方法效率有限。现有研究缺乏对多种元启发式算法在印度抗震规范（IS 1893、IS 456、IS 13920）约束下进行系统性比较的基准测试。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体智能元启发式算法（PSO及其变体FIPSO、灰狼优化GWO、鲸鱼优化WOA）；约束非线性规划；基于Open API的有限元-优化集成框架。
AI.method: 将RC框架优化建模为16维约束非线性规划（变量：按楼层分组的柱截面、梁高、梁柱纵筋配筋率）；通过SAP2000 OAPI实现分析-设计全自动化闭环；采用"捕捉-层级"程序确保可施工性；施加IS 1893:2016层间位移角限值、IS 456:2000强度规定、IS 13920:2016延性标准（节点处SCWB比≥1.4）。
AI.findings: PSO在720次评估中获得最低成本（基准）；WOA、FIPSO、GWO分别产生1.87%、5.90%、12.04%的成本溢价，评估次数分别为580、440、300。最小SCWB比范围为1.574~2.255，最大层间位移角为0.37%~0.39%，均满足规范限值（0.40%）。FIPSO以比PSO少39%的评估次数仅付出5.90%的成本溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个满足印度抗震规范且集成SAP2000 OAPI的RC框架多算法优化基准；揭示了不同群体智能算法在建筑结构优化中的解质量与计算效率的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度地震区RC框架设计提供了经过验证的自动化优化框架和算法选择指南，PSO适用于追求最低成本，FIPSO适用于计算资源有限场景下的高效设计。

title: From Rural Land to Modern Finance: The Digital Credit Spillover of a Property Rights Reform
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - School of Business, City University of Hong Kong, Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) and Lingnan University

detail.title: From Rural Land to Modern Finance: The Digital Credit Spillover of a Property Rights Reform
detail.abstract: This paper studies how the property-rights reform spills into digital credit. We exploit China's 2016 policy that, for the first time, allowed rural households to use land-use rights as collateral for bank loans. Using a difference-in-differences design on peer-to-peer (P2P) lending data, we find that the reform significantly improved credit demand and loan performance for male borrowers, who predominantly hold land rights. Conversely, these effects are absent for female borrowers. Treated males secured larger P2P loans at lower interest rates and had lower default rates. These findings highlight a borrower-side collateral channel linking traditional institutions to modern digital finance.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用中国2016年允许农村居民以土地使用权抵押贷款的政策，采用双重差分法分析P2P借贷数据，发现该改革显著改善了男性借款人的信贷需求和贷款表现（贷款规模更大、利率更低、违约率更低），但对女性借款人无显著影响，揭示了传统产权制度向数字金融溢出的借款人侧抵押渠道。
AI.research_question: 产权制度改革如何溢出影响数字信贷市场？具体而言，允许农村居民以土地使用权作为银行贷款抵押品的政策，如何影响P2P网贷市场的借贷行为和贷款表现？
AI.motivation: 传统产权制度改革（如土地确权与抵押合法化）如何影响新兴数字金融市场，这一溢出机制尚不明确。产权制度是否通过借款人侧的抵押渠道传导至现代数字金融，是本研究要回答的核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产权理论（产权明晰降低交易成本、增强信贷可得性）、抵押渠道理论（抵押品缓解逆向选择与道德风险）、性别差异与信贷市场理论（土地权利持有的性别不平等导致改革效果异质性）
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用中国2016年允许农村土地使用权抵押贷款的政策冲击，基于P2P网贷平台借贷数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）改革显著改善了男性借款人的信贷需求和贷款表现——男性借款人获得更大规模的P2P贷款、更低的利率、更低的违约率。（2）这些效应在女性借款人中完全不存在。（3）表明存在一条从传统产权制度到现代数字金融的借款人侧抵押渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将产权制度改革与数字金融联系起来，揭示了传统制度到现代金融的"抵押渠道"溢出机制；拓展了产权理论在数字金融场景下的适用范围；从性别视角揭示了土地权利不平等在数字信贷市场中的体现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了产权制度改革对金融科技市场溢出效应的实证证据；提示政策制定者在推进土地确权与抵押合法化时需关注性别不平等问题；为数字信贷平台的风险评估与产品设计提供参考。

title: Physicochemical and tribological characterisation of epoxidised Peganum harmala L. seed oil as a non-edible bio-lubricant base stock
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Kashmir

detail.title: Physicochemical and tribological characterisation of epoxidised Peganum harmala L. seed oil as a non-edible bio-lubricant base stock
detail.abstract: The reliance on petroleum-based lubricants has accelerated interest in sustainable bio-lubricants, yet most still rely on edible feedstocks. Here, seed oil from Peganum harmala L., a non-edible arid-region weed, was converted into a bio-lubricant by single-step in-situ epoxidation and compared with a commercial SAE 5W-30 synthetic oil. To our knowledge, the tribological behaviour of Peganum harmala seed oil as a lubricant has not been previously reported. Epoxidation reduced the total acid number from 5.47 to 0.07 mg KOH g-1 and the iodine value from 130 to 7.7 mg I2 (100 g)-1. FTIR confirmed consumption of the C=C bands at 1654 and the appearance of the oxirane C-O-C band, with a weaker O-H band indicating partial ring-opening to vicinal diols. The epoxidised oil showed a flash point of 245 ºC, close to the reference (242 ºC), and a kinematic viscosity at 100 ºC of 10.5 mm2 s-1, with a viscosity index of approximately 180. Under ASTM D4172 four-ball boundary lubrication, EPHL gave a steady-state coefficient of friction of 0.063 and a wear scar diameter of 0.52 mm, 58% below the native oil and 32% below the 5W-30 reference for friction, and 74% below the native oil for wear. In reciprocating sliding, all three lubricants showed similarly low friction. SEM, EDX and Raman analyses indicated reduced wear and oxidation, with no detectable phosphorus on the wear scars, consistent with a thin polar-adsorbed boundary film stabilised by oxirane and vicinal-diol functionality. The main remaining limitation is the poor cold-flow behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文首次报道了将非食用性干旱区杂草——骆驼蓬（Peganum harmala L.）籽油通过一步法原位环氧化转化为生物润滑剂，其摩擦学性能优于商品合成油SAE 5W-30，摩擦系数降低32%，磨损减少74%，具有显著的可持续润滑潜力。
AI.research_question: 非食用性干旱区杂草骆驼蓬籽油经环氧化改性后能否作为高性能生物润滑剂，其摩擦学性能是否优于传统合成油？
AI.motivation: 石油基润滑剂的环境压力促使人们寻找可持续的生物润滑剂，但现有生物润滑剂多依赖食用性原料。骆驼蓬籽油来自非食用性干旱区杂草，不与粮食竞争，具有可持续性优势，但其润滑性能尚未被研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环氧化反应原理：通过原位环氧化将不饱和C=C键转化为环氧基团（oxirane），改善氧化稳定性和润滑性能；边界润滑理论：极性基团（环氧基、邻位二醇）在金属表面形成物理吸附薄膜，降低摩擦磨损。
AI.method: 一步法原位环氧化改性；FTIR表征化学结构变化；ASTM D4172四球边界润滑测试和往复滑动测试评估摩擦学性能；SEM、EDX、Raman分析磨损表面。
AI.findings: 1) 环氧化后酸值从5.47降至0.07 mg KOH g-1，碘值从130降至7.7 mg I2 (100 g)-1；2) 闪点245℃接近商用油（242℃），100℃运动粘度10.5 mm2 s-1，粘度指数约180；3) 稳态摩擦系数0.063，磨损直径0.52 mm，摩擦比原籽油降低58%、比5W-30降低32%，磨损比原籽油降低74%；4) 磨损表面无磷检测，表明形成极化吸附边界膜。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示了骆驼蓬籽油作为润滑剂的摩擦学行为，证实了环氧基和邻位二醇基团在金属表面形成极性吸附边界膜的减摩抗磨机理，拓展了非食用性植物油在绿色润滑领域的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种利用干旱区非食用杂草籽油生产高性能生物润滑剂的可行方案，一步法工艺简单高效，产品在摩擦、磨损和热稳定性方面优于商用合成油，具有替代石油基润滑剂的潜力，但需解决低温流动性问题。

title: Labour Problems in Indian MSME Manufacturing Labour Problems in Indian MSME Manufacturing: Gig Economy, Seasonal Migration, and the Cost of Living Crisis

detail.title: Labour Problems in Indian MSME Manufacturing Labour Problems in Indian MSME Manufacturing: Gig Economy, Seasonal Migration, and the Cost of Living Crisis
detail.abstract: India's Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (MSME) sector-contributing approximately 30% of GDP and employing over 110 million workers-is confronting a deepening and multidimensional labour crisis. This paper identifies and examines three interconnected phenomena that are collectively destabilising the workforce of Indian MSME manufacturers: (1) the rise of the gig economy and e-rickshaw sector as credible autonomous income alternatives; (2) the cyclical disruption caused by seasonal labour migration to agricultural home states; and (3) the accelerating reverse migration of urban factory workers to their villages, driven by a severe cost of living crisis linked to the 2026 US-Iran conflict and its disruption of the Strait of Hormuz, which triggered a global LPG and energy price shock. Drawing on key informant interviews with 5 to 10 MSME stakeholders across Delhi, Haryana, and Rajasthan-spanning the furniture, footwear, steel, and garments sectors-this exploratory qualitative study documents a structural breakdown in the labour availability, discipline, and retention that Indian MSMEs have historically depended upon. The paper argues that what owners experience as isolated operational inconveniences are in fact symptoms of a systemic realignment: labour that was once structurally captive to factory employment now holds multiple credible exit options-autonomous gig income, seasonal agricultural return, and economically-motivated village retreat. Each exit path individually weakens MSME operational resilience; together, they represent an existential challenge to the labour model underpinning Indian small manufacturing. Policy implications are drawn for MSME management practices, industry cluster coordination, and government intervention in labour formalisation, skilling, and energy subsidy design.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度MSME制造业面临的三大劳动力危机：零工经济崛起、季节性农业移民、以及2026年美伊冲突引发的生活成本危机导致的城市工厂工人返乡潮，认为这些现象共同构成对印度小型制造业劳动力模式的系统性挑战。
AI.research_question: 印度MSME制造业正面临怎样的劳动力危机？这些危机如何系统性地颠覆传统的劳动力供给模式？
AI.motivation: 印度MSME部门贡献约30%GDP并雇佣超1.1亿工人，但正面临日益加深的多维劳动力危机，亟需系统性的学术关注与政策回应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力结构性重组理论、多维退出选择理论（自主零工收入、季节性农业回归、经济驱动的村庄撤退）
AI.method: 探索性定性研究，对德里、哈里亚纳邦和拉贾斯坦邦的5-10名MSME利益相关者进行关键信息提供者访谈，涵盖家具、鞋类、钢铁和服装行业。
AI.findings: 劳动力从结构性被俘获转向拥有多重可信退出选项：自主零工收入、季节性农业回归、经济驱动的村庄撤退；每个退出路径单独削弱MSME运营韧性，共同构成对劳动力模式的生存威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并概念化了MSME劳动力危机的三种相互关联的现象，将零散的操作性不便系统性地解释为劳动力模式的系统性重构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为MSME管理实践、行业集群协调、以及政府在劳动力正规化、技能培训和能源补贴设计方面的干预提供政策启示。

title: Resource Booms and the Composition of Birth Outcomes: Evidence from California Oil Production

detail.title: Resource Booms and the Composition of Birth Outcomes: Evidence from California Oil Production
detail.abstract: This paper studies how upstream oil production affects the size and demographic composition of producing counties in California, and the consequences for the county-level burden of low birth weight. Using a county-year panel of oil production records and birth outcomes from 1995 to 2021, I estimate an instrumental variables model that interacts historical county oil and gas employment shares with lagged national oil production to isolate plausibly exogenous variation in local production. I decompose the aggregate response into a composition channel, the number of births per resident, and a per-birth health channel, the probability of low birth weight per birth. Evaluated at the mean level of county oil production, the estimates imply an increase of 0.056 moderate low birth weight cases per 1,000 residents and 0.881 total births per 1,000 residents, while the estimated effect on low birth weight per birth is statistically indistinguishable from zero. The ratio of the two significant responses recovers the baseline rate of low birth weight per birth, indicating that the aggregate burden operates through the composition channel rather than through a detectable change in per-birth health risk. Subgroup estimates further indicate that the composition response is concentrated in births to Hispanic mothers, mothers of peak childbearing age, and less-educated mothers. The result is robust to alternative shift-share constructions and base years, and to leave-one-out estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1995-2021年加州县级面板数据，通过工具变量法发现上游石油生产通过增加出生数量（而非降低每出生婴儿健康质量）来加重低出生体重负担，且该效应集中在西班牙裔、育龄高峰和低教育程度母亲群体中。
AI.research_question: 上游石油生产如何影响产油县的人口规模、人口构成以及县级低出生体重负担？
AI.motivation: 化石燃料开采对当地社区的健康影响一直是公共政策关注焦点，但以往研究大多关注污染暴露直接导致的健康效应，而忽略了石油生产通过改变人口规模和构成（如吸引更多育龄人口迁入）间接影响健康负担的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口构成效应（composition channel）与每出生婴儿健康效应（per-birth health channel）的双渠道分解框架。前者指石油生产通过影响出生数量改变低出生体重总负担，后者指石油生产通过影响每名婴儿的健康水平改变低出生体重概率。
AI.method: 县级-年度面板数据（1995-2021），工具变量法：将历史县级石油和天然气就业份额与滞后的全国石油产量交互，构造局部石油产量的外生变动。使用巴斯分解法将总效应分解为人口构成渠道和每出生婴儿健康渠道。
AI.findings: （1）在县级石油平均产量水平上，每千名居民低出生体重病例增加0.056例，每千名居民总出生数增加0.881例；（2）每出生婴儿低出生体重概率的效应统计上不显著；（3）总负担效应完全通过人口构成渠道而非每出生婴儿健康渠道起作用；（4）构成效应集中在西班牙裔母亲、育龄高峰母亲（25-34岁）和低教育程度母亲群体中。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出并实证检验了"人口构成渠道"作为资源开采影响公共健康的新机制，超越了传统污染暴露的直接健康效应研究；（2）通过分解框架区分了人口规模变化与个体健康风险变化两种截然不同的影响路径，为理解产业冲击的健康后果提供了更精细的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提示政策制定者关注石油生产繁荣期医疗资源（如产科和新生儿护理）的配套需求，因为低出生体重负担上升主要源于出生人数增加而非婴儿健康恶化；（2）为产油地区制定针对性的公共卫生干预策略提供依据，尤其是面向西班牙裔、育龄高峰和低教育程度母亲的健康服务规划。

title: The Webtoon Paradox: Creator Abundance, Platform Capture, and the Discovery Gap

detail.title: The Webtoon Paradox: Creator Abundance, Platform Capture, and the Discovery Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract: This study examines the economic design of the digital webtoon industry, evaluating the wealth distribution gap between platform operators and independent content creators. By analyzing WEBTOON Entertainment's financial disclosures alongside macro-industry data from the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA), we model how open-access content ecosystems concentrate capital at the platform layer while shifting systemic risk downward. A comparative market analysis reveals that the webtoon sector replicates the structural labor dynamics of the YouTube creator economy, where content abundance, algorithmic gatekeeping, and back-loaded revenue-sharing frameworks combine to compress baseline creator returns. In 2023, while WEBTOON Entertainment capitalized on a global pool of 24 million registered creators to scale its market footprint, only 483 individuals achieved annual earnings over $100,000, representing 0.002% of the active base. KOCCA data confirms this platform-capture dynamic, showing a stark divergence where platform operating profits expanded as independent content producer margins turned negative. This paper details the operational mechanics of this asymmetric marketplace, outlines three forward-looking industry trajectories, and provides strategic implications for media investors, antitrust regulators, and digital platform architects.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了数字网漫行业的经济设计，揭示了平台运营商与独立内容创作者之间的财富分配不均。通过分析WEBTOON Entertainment的财务披露和KOCCA的宏观行业数据，发现开放式内容生态系统将资本集中在平台层，同时将系统性风险向下转移。2023年，尽管WEBTOON Entertainment拥有2400万注册创作者，但仅有483人（0.002%）年收入超过10万美元。平台运营利润增长的同时，独立内容生产者的利润率却转为负值。
AI.research_question: 数字网漫行业中，平台运营商与独立内容创作者之间的财富分配差距是如何形成的？这种不对称市场结构的运作机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 网漫行业快速增长但创作者收入高度集中的现象引发了对数字创意经济中财富分配公平性的关注，揭示平台经济下的结构性不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台经济理论、创作者经济劳动动力学、资本集中与风险下沉理论、算法门控与收入分享框架理论。
AI.method: 财务披露分析（WEBTOON Entertainment）、宏观行业数据分析（KOCCA）、比较市场分析（与YouTube创作者经济对比）、定量统计与趋势建模。
AI.findings: 1）网漫行业复制了YouTube创作者经济的结构性劳动动态；2）内容过剩、算法门控和后置收入分享框架压缩了创作者基础回报；3）2023年仅0.002%的活跃创作者年收入超过10万美元；4）平台运营利润扩张的同时独立创作者利润率转负，呈现"平台捕获"动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平台经济与创作者经济不平等理论扩展到数字网漫这一新兴垂直领域，提出了"平台捕获动态"的概念，揭示了开放内容生态中资本集中与风险下沉的系统性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体投资者、反垄断监管者和数字平台架构师提供了三项前瞻性行业轨迹预测及战略启示，有助于理解数字创意产业的结构性风险并制定相关政策。

title: The Cost of Fragmentation: Geoeconomic Risk and Corporate Capital Structure Inertia
affiliations: CICEE - Research Center in Business & Economics, Universidade Católica Portuguesa, Católica Porto Business School and CEGE, CMVM - Comissao do Mercado de Valores Mobiliarios and University of Aveiro - Department of Economics, Management, Industrial Engineering and Tourism

detail.title: The Cost of Fragmentation: Geoeconomic Risk and Corporate Capital Structure Inertia
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how geoeconomic fragmentation (GEF) affects corporate capital structure dynamics. Challenging the implicit assumption of a stable global economic order in canonical trade-off models, we hypothesise that GEF constitutes a systemic, regime-changing shock that not only elevates adjustment costs but also destabilises the target leverage ratio itself. Using a dynamic partial adjustment framework on a panel of 121,454 medium-to-large non-financial firms across the European Union from 2015 to 2024, we document a significant reduction in the speed of adjustment (SOA) towards target leverage under heightened GEF risk. This inertia is most pronounced for firms with larger target deviations, indicating a breakdown of the market-disciplining mechanism. We identify three primary transmission channels-elevated cost of external finance, increased cash flow volatility, and strategic inertia driven by real options-and find that the effect is heterogeneous, amplified for firms in geoeconomically sensitive sectors and for financially constrained firms. However, firms with complex global supply chains exhibit faster adjustment, consistent with restructuring-driven deleveraging. Our findings quantify the "cost of fragmentation" in terms of heightened market frictions and offer actionable insights for policymakers and corporate treasurers navigating an era of systemic geoeconomic risk. The paper bridges corporate finance with strategic management, revealing how financing decisions are embedded in broader organisational processes of adaptation and resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了地缘经济碎片化如何影响企业资本结构动态，发现GEF显著降低了企业向目标杠杆率的调整速度，且该效应通过外部融资成本上升、现金流波动增加和战略惯性三个渠道传导，对地缘敏感行业和财务受限企业影响更大。
AI.research_question: 地缘经济碎片化（GEF）如何影响企业资本结构的调整动态？
AI.motivation: 传统的资本结构权衡模型隐含假设全球经济秩序稳定，忽略了系统性、制度性的地缘政治冲击对企业融资决策的影响。本研究旨在量化"碎片化的成本"，填补公司金融与战略管理交叉领域的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态部分调整模型；权衡理论；市场纪律机制；实物期权理论；供应链重组理论
AI.method: 基于2015-2024年欧盟121,454家非金融企业的面板数据，采用动态部分调整框架进行实证分析，并识别了三个主要传导渠道。
AI.findings: (1) GEF显著降低企业向目标杠杆率的调整速度（SOA）；(2) 目标偏离越大的企业，调整惯性越强，说明市场纪律机制失效；(3) 三个传导渠道：外部融资成本上升、现金流波动加剧、基于实物期权的战略惯性；(4) 效应在敏感行业和财务受限企业中更显著；(5) 拥有复杂全球供应链的企业调整速度更快，符合重组驱动的去杠杆化逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘经济碎片化作为系统性、制度性的外生冲击纳入资本结构动态分析，挑战了传统权衡模型中对稳定全球经济秩序的隐含假设，揭示了融资决策嵌入在更广泛的组织适应与韧性构建过程之中。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了地缘经济碎片化的"成本"，为政策制定者应对系统性地缘经济风险提供可操作洞见；为企业财务主管在碎片化环境中的资本结构管理提供决策参考。

title: Process-safety-oriented inspect-first decision support for corrosion-related production tubing failure prevention in oilfield operations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Process-safety-oriented inspect-first decision support for corrosion-related production tubing failure prevention in oilfield operations
detail.abstract: Corrosion-related production tubing failures are a loss-prevention problem in oilfield operations because downhole tubing degradation remains only partially observable before inspection or workover. Reactive failures can lead to unplanned well interventions, deferred production, integrity exposure, and inefficient allocation of limited diagnostic capacity. This study develops a process-safety-oriented inspect-first decision-support framework that links leakage-controlled failure ranking, grouped and field-level validation, scenario-validity screening, expected value of inspection logic, and oil-rate-weighted portfolio prioritization. The framework is evaluated on 957 wells from 26 fields, including 263 corrosion-related tubing failures. The selected logistic regression model achieved grouped out-of-fold ROC-AUC of 0.887 and leave-one-field-out pooled AUC of 0.739. At 20% inspection capacity, the model captured 57.8% of observed failures in the primary conservative evaluation, approximately twice the NORSOK-derived baseline in the full-fleet backtest. Scenario-validity gates prevented unsupported preventive actions from being converted into operational recommendations. Under conservative base-case economics, direct preventive workover was not standalone value-positive at fleet scale; therefore, high-risk wells were routed toward inspection or monitoring rather than automatic intervention. The contribution is an auditable decision layer for process-safety-oriented inspection allocation under incomplete observability, rather than a causal treatment-effect model or a universal corrosion-rate predictor.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个面向过程安全的"先检查后决策"框架，将泄漏控制失效排序、分组与油田级验证、场景有效性筛选、检查期望值逻辑和产量加权组合优先级排序相结合。基于26个油田957口井（含263起腐蚀相关管柱失效）的评估显示，逻辑回归模型分组ROC-AUC达0.887，以20%检查能力捕获了57.8%的观测失效，约为NORSOK基准的两倍。在保守经济假设下，直接预防性修井在油田规模上不具独立价值，高风险井被导向检查或监测而非自动干预。
AI.research_question: 如何在不完全可观测条件下，构建一个面向过程安全的检查优先级决策框架，以优化油田生产管柱腐蚀失效的预防资源配置？
AI.motivation: 井下管柱腐蚀退化在检查或修井前仅部分可观测，导致反应性失效引发非计划干预、产量损失、完整性风险及有限诊断资源的低效分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过程安全导向的检查优先决策框架，整合泄漏控制失效排序、分组与油田级交叉验证、场景有效性筛查、检查期望值（EVI）逻辑、产量加权组合优先级排序。
AI.method: 基于26个油田957口井（含263起腐蚀失效）的真实数据，采用逻辑回归模型，进行分组折外验证（ROC-AUC 0.887）和留一油田外验证（pooled AUC 0.739），并与NORSOK标准基线进行全船队回测对比。
AI.findings: (1) 逻辑回归模型分组ROC-AUC为0.887，留一油田外AUC为0.739；(2) 20%检查能力下捕获57.8%观测失效，约为NORSOK基准两倍；(3) 场景有效性门控防止了无依据的预防性行动转化为操作建议；(4) 保守经济下直接预防性修井在油田规模上不具独立正价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可审计的决策层框架，用于在信息不完全可观测条件下进行过程安全导向的检查资源分配，而非因果处理效应模型或通用腐蚀速率预测器。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 显著提升有限检查资源的失效捕获效率（20%能力捕获57.8%失效）；(2) 场景有效性门控避免无效预防行动转化为操作建议；(3) 高风险井被导向检查/监测而非自动干预，避免资源浪费；(4) 提供可审计、可追溯的决策支持流程。

title: Friction and wear analysis between carbon fiber tow and stainless-steel guide roller during 3D weaving process
affiliations: Donghua University, Donghua University and Donghua University

detail.title: Friction and wear analysis between carbon fiber tow and stainless-steel guide roller during 3D weaving process
detail.abstract: This study designed a laboratory bench to simulate the friction between carbon fiber tow and stainless-steel guide roller during 3D weaving process. It investigated the influence patterns of three research variables—stainless-steel guide radius, carbon fiber tow wrap angle, and incoming tension—on friction and wear behavior. The study first analyzed the influence of each variable on friction force, establishing a fitted relationship model between stainless-steel guide radius and power-law friction parameters. Based on this, a outgoing tension prediction equation incorporating three variables was formulated. Furthermore, a predictive model for the tensile load loss rate was developed using the Gradient Boosting algorithm. The results indicate that all three factors exert highly significant effects on both friction force and wear severity. Among them, radius exhibits strong nonlinear effects, while incoming tension and wrap angle demonstrate monotonic trends. The relationship between radius and power-law friction parameters can be precisely described by a rational function with both numerator and denominator being quadratic. The outgoing tension prediction model exhibits an error below 0.1 N, demonstrating excellent prediction accuracy. For wear prediction, the model featuring radius, contact arc length, and incoming tension as input achieved an average prediction error of 0.8414% for the tensile load loss rate of 18 data points. Compared to the model using radius, wrap angle, and incoming tension as inputs, this reduced prediction error by 26.52%, exhibiting higher engineering applicability. These findings provide a theoretical foundation and engineering guidance for the stainless-steel guide roller system of carbon fiber 3D loom.

AI.tldr: 本研究搭建实验台模拟碳纤维丝束与不锈钢导向辊在三维编织中的摩擦行为，分析了导向辊半径、包角和来纱张力对摩擦力和磨损的影响，建立了张力预测方程和基于梯度提升算法的拉伸载荷损失率预测模型。
AI.research_question: 碳纤维丝束与不锈钢导向辊在三维编织过程中的摩擦与磨损行为受哪些因素影响？如何建立摩擦力和拉伸载荷损失率的预测模型？
AI.motivation: 碳纤维三维编织过程中，丝束与导向辊之间的摩擦磨损严重影响编织质量和丝束性能，缺乏系统的实验研究和准确的预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 摩擦学理论、幂律摩擦模型、梯度提升算法（Gradient Boosting）
AI.method: 搭建实验室台架模拟摩擦实验；分析半径、包角、来纱张力三个变量的影响；建立半径与幂律摩擦参数的有理函数拟合关系；构建多变量出纱张力预测方程；采用梯度提升算法建立拉伸载荷损失率预测模型。
AI.findings: 三个变量对摩擦力和磨损均有极显著影响；半径具有强非线性效应，来纱张力和包角呈单调趋势；半径与幂律摩擦参数的关系可用分子分母均为二次的有理函数精确描述；出纱张力预测误差低于0.1N；以半径、接触弧长、来纱张力为输入的磨损预测模型平均误差为0.8414%，比以半径、包角、来纱张力为输入的模型误差降低26.52%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不锈钢导向辊半径与幂律摩擦参数之间的有理函数关系；建立了多变量出纱张力预测方程；提出了基于梯度提升算法的磨损预测方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳纤维三维织机的不锈钢导向辊系统设计提供了理论依据和工程指导；所提出的预测模型具有较高的工程适用性，可帮助优化编织工艺参数。
